compiled_state.title: Document telemetry infrastructure config keys and setup sequence in CONFIGURATION-REFERENCE.md and INSTALL.md
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Testing Mode
GREEN (doc-only per behavioral-testing-standard.md Rule 5)

## Story DD Coverage
- dd-1: CONFIGURATION-REFERENCE.md includes new telemetry config keys with types, defaults, descriptions
- dd-2: INSTALL.md includes "Telemetry Infrastructure" section
- dd-3: DOC_ROUTER_ATTESTATION block in completion report

## Files to Edit
- plugins/dso/docs/CONFIGURATION-REFERENCE.md
- INSTALL.md

## Config keys to document (CONFIGURATION-REFERENCE.md)
- review_telemetry.endpoint_url (string) — Lambda Function URL for POSTs
- review_telemetry.bucket_name (string) — S3 bucket for NDJSON
- review_telemetry.lambda_function_name (string)
- review_telemetry.iam_role_name (string)
- review_telemetry.lambda_function_url (string) — mirrors endpoint_url
- review_telemetry.aws_account_id (string)
- telemetry.endpoint_url (string)
- telemetry.s3_bucket_name (string)
- telemetry.enabled (boolean, default: false)

## INSTALL.md "Telemetry Infrastructure" section requirements
- Prerequisites: AWS credentials, DuckDB CLI, bash 4+
- Setup sequence: aws-setup-bucket.sh → aws-setup-lambda.sh → aws-deploy-handler.sh → aws-verify-live.sh
- Per-script: one-line purpose, invocation command, expected output marker
- Teardown reference: aws-teardown.sh
- Status check: aws-status.sh

## Out of scope
- CLAUDE.md edits (Gate 5 unsatisfied — see architectural invariant 1; route via CLAUDE_MD_SUGGESTED_CHANGE if needed)
- New telemetry features

## DOC_ROUTER_ATTESTATION (dd-3) deliverable
The story completion report MUST include:
```
DOC_ROUTER_ATTESTATION:
  gate_fired: true
  target_files:
    - plugins/dso/docs/CONFIGURATION-REFERENCE.md
    - INSTALL.md
  claude_md_edited: no
  rationale: telemetry config keys are not every-session orchestrator rules
```

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass
  Verify: TEST_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.test_unit) && [ -n "$TEST_CMD" ] && $TEST_CMD
- [ ] Lint passes
  Verify: LINT_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.lint) && [ -n "$LINT_CMD" ] && $LINT_CMD
- [ ] CONFIGURATION-REFERENCE.md documents all 9 telemetry keys
  Verify: for k in review_telemetry.endpoint_url review_telemetry.bucket_name review_telemetry.lambda_function_name review_telemetry.iam_role_name review_telemetry.lambda_function_url review_telemetry.aws_account_id telemetry.endpoint_url telemetry.s3_bucket_name telemetry.enabled; do grep -q "$k" plugins/dso/docs/CONFIGURATION-REFERENCE.md || exit 1; done
- [ ] Every telemetry key states a type
  Verify: for k in review_telemetry.endpoint_url review_telemetry.bucket_name telemetry.enabled; do grep -E -q "${k}.*(string|boolean|integer|number)" plugins/dso/docs/CONFIGURATION-REFERENCE.md || exit 1; done
- [ ] INSTALL.md has Telemetry Infrastructure section heading
  Verify: grep -E -q '^#+\s+Telemetry Infrastructure' INSTALL.md
- [ ] INSTALL.md references all 4 setup scripts
  Verify: for s in aws-setup-bucket.sh aws-setup-lambda.sh aws-deploy-handler.sh aws-verify-live.sh; do grep -q "$s" INSTALL.md || exit 1; done
- [ ] AWS credentials + DuckDB prerequisites mentioned
  Verify: grep -E -qi 'AWS credentials|~/.aws/credentials' INSTALL.md && grep -qi 'DuckDB' INSTALL.md
- [ ] All referenced telemetry scripts exist on disk
  Verify: for s in aws-setup-bucket.sh aws-setup-lambda.sh aws-deploy-handler.sh aws-verify-live.sh aws-status.sh aws-teardown.sh; do grep -q "$s" INSTALL.md && [ -f "plugins/dso/scripts/telemetry/$s" ] || exit 1; done
- [ ] CLAUDE.md NOT modified
  Verify: ! git diff --name-only HEAD~1 HEAD | grep -q '^CLAUDE.md$'

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
